video_crop.name: Crop & trim
video_crop.desc: Crops a video to 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9 and, if you like, cuts the start and end.
video_crop.help: Pick a video, a format and which part to keep (centre, left/top or right/bottom). You can also give a start and end, in seconds or as mm:ss. The picture is cut as large as possible without black bars; the rotation from the phone is taken into account. Result: <name>.crop.mp4 next to the original. Needs ffmpeg.
video_crop.ask_end: End (seconds or mm:ss, Enter = to the end):
video_crop.bad_time: Invalid time. Values from 0 to {limit} s are allowed, e.g. 12 or 0:12.
video_crop.end_before_start: The end must come after the start.
video_crop.nothing_to_do: Nothing to do: format and length stay the same.
video_crop.working: Cropping, this can take a while on a phone …
